game.rules:
# Game Rules

Running the game on unmodified software is perfectly acceptable, and it is recommended for beginners. However, certain modifications are permitted and/or explicitly forbidden:

## Allowed modifications:

- Setting “bEnableMouseSmoothing” to “FALSE” in “TdInput.ini” is allowed and recommended. Feel free to ask in our Discord if you want help with this.
- Community-approved macros that spam the “Jump” command and the “Use” command (in order to simulate freescroll) are allowed. In general, spam macros are allowed for any in-game actions that you can normally bind a scroll wheel to (i.e. no binding spam macros to Menu actions, like Escape and Enter). Ask in our community Discord for any guidance.
- Custom FOVs mods are allowed.
- Custom textures using Toyro's method are allowed. (for cosmetic purposes only)
- Modifications and/or custom keybinds to set the game to windowed mode are allowed.

## Banned modifications:

- FPS must be locked between 60 and 62, which the game will do by default. Unlocking the FPS is not allowed. Locking the FPS below 60 or above 62 is not allowed.
- Using external software (e.g. a GPU limiter) or Windows-functionality (i.e. holding print-screen) to artificially increase loading times is not allowed.
- Runs done on the “multiplayer mod” are not allowed.

## Submissions

- For full-game runs, please **do not** include milliseconds. For individual-level runs, please **do** include milliseconds. 
- Make sure to double-check that your Platform (PC, Xbox 360, PS3, etc.) and Category (Any%, Glitchless, Inbounds) are both correct before you submit. 
- Individual chapter speedruns must be done in the in-game "Speedrun" mode.

## Additional Proof

Due to the accessibility of tools and trainers, additional proof may be required for suspicious runs, at the moderators’ discretion. If this is the case, you will be contacted by a moderator. Keep in mind: it is **much more likely** that you will be contacted about this if you do not have a load-removing timer on screen during your full-game runs.

categories.name: Any%
categories.rules:
Time start and end should be automatic if you're using the autosplitter in Livesplit (highly recommended). If not, time starts on New Game and ends on the Helicopter Grab.

Beat the game as fast as possible, no additional restrictions.

categories.name: Glitchless
categories.rules:
Time start and end should be automatic if you're using the autosplitter in Livesplit (highly recommended). If not, time starts on New Game and ends on the Helicopter Grab.

Complete the game with the following restrictions:

1) No out-of-bounds. This includes entering out-of-bounds areas, and wallrunning or wallclimbing on out-of-bounds walls. Clarifications can be made on a case-by-case basis.

2) No kickglitch. This includes jumping, sidestepping, sliding, and using the pick up/drop action during the one-frame grounded state created by the wallrun-kick, roll, pick up/drop, and damage animations.

3) No use glitch.

4) No intentional beamers. Unintentional beamers that do not save time will be allowed at moderator discretion. A beamer is any form of instantaneous, framerate-dependent acceleration.

5) No clipping through walls, floors, and ceilings.

6) No instant 180-degree swing turns.

7) No Chapter 8 sniper skip (AKA "Truckbang.")

8) Stormdrains flingboard, Stormdrains Exit swing fling, and Atrium flingboard are not allowed.

Unlike in individual level runs, strangs in full-game Glitchless runs are allowed.

Note: Some runs on this leaderboard may violate one or more of these rules, but have been grandfathered in due to rule changes throughout the years. Contact a moderator with any questions or concerns.

categories.name: Glitchless
categories.rules:
Complete the game, with restrictions.

1) No out of bounds. This includes running through out of bounds areas, as well as wallrunning on a clearly out-of-bounds wall. This also includes hitting out-of-bounds loading triggers, e.g. Chapter 8 sniper skip. Clarifications can be made on a case-by-case basis. 

2) No kickglitch. This includes: Jumping, Sidejumping, or doing the Pick Up / Drop command using the one-frame grounded state created by the wallrun-kick, roll, or damage animations.

3) No use glitch.

4) No intentional beamers. Unintentional beamers that do not save time will be allowed at the discretion of the moderators.

5) No clipping through floors, walls, and ceilings.

6) Strangs are not allowed. This only applies to Individual Level runs.

Note: Some runs on this leaderboard may violate one or more of these rules, but have been grandfathered in due to rule clarifications throughout the years. Contact a moderator with any questions or concerns.

Sub 29 hell yeah!

38 seconds faster than the previous pb without canoli/tacconoli. That's fine. Huge possible timesave in chapter 3 for future runs...
